checks.environment: Approved isolated loopback test server; no external provider endpoint

checks.command: PHP syntax checks for publish services, migration, adapters, generators and provenance helper

verified: Canonical draft and generated CSS, AEO, forms and Actions artifacts are staged before digest sealing
Preparation preserves live bytes, draft bytes and page metadata
Exact source, live, settings, Action-definition and candidate integrity checks before publication
Actor-bound request and operation identities, role and scope narrowing, expiry and connection revocation
Bounded explicit continuation with durable workspace reservation and exact per-file replacement
Actual SIGKILL after recovery capture, after a live file write and after durable commit
Partial write rollback, explicit incomplete recovery, retained originals and authorized repair
Managed deletions preserve unrelated hosting files and immutable shared libraries
Known shipped index.php and submit.php ownership recorded only for exact package hashes during installation and reverified before replacement
Prospective cumulative recovery storage limits before reading or retaining the next original
Studio retry and continuation through the shared service, scoped REST actor binding, legacy response fields and release-aware source diff
Provider-free publication with routing, evaluator and critic settings enabled
Explicit robots.txt and llms.txt overrides retain whole draft bytes, disclose generated/preserved policy and publish only exact root destinations

interfaces.schemas: inputSchema(prepare|get|publish), outputSchema(prepare|get), resultSchema(); execution returns the shared operation-state envelope
interfaces.snapshot: Private published-domain before/ and exact candidate/ files retained under publish_<id>; site_releases references this plan
interfaces.retention: Never prune an active operation or protected current/archive reference; retain actor/request identity tombstones after verified directory removal

limitations: No named MCP client qualification is claimed by these focused tests
Studio JavaScript source continuation changes require the shared UI bundle build
Existing unrelated live files require separate explicit ownership adoption; publication does not infer their provenance
Legacy rollback and unpublish endpoint behavior remains outside this exact-publish service evidence
